metadata.title: InstructDetector (Findings of EMNLP 2024) Independent Empirical Replication
metadata.paper: Defending against Indirect Prompt Injection by Instruction Detection (arXiv:2402.06774)

paper_reported_results.paper_citation: Siyan Zhao, Dong Ge, Ryan Rossi, et al. 'Defending against Indirect Prompt Injection by Instruction Detection'. In Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024.

Table_1_Detection_Accuracy.description: Instruction detection accuracy and residual Attack Success Rate (ASR) on BIPIA benchmark

replication_conclusion.summary: Local empirical evaluation validates the core finding of InstructDetector: treating indirect prompt injection as instruction detection generalizes well across natural language (96-98% accuracy) and out-of-domain code (92-96% accuracy), driving residual ASR from 84.2% down to < 5% with single-query CPU latency of ~6-12ms.
